name: DarkMESA
summary: DarkMESA is proposed downstream of the MESA P2 beam dump at Johannes Gutenberg University Mainz. It is a dedicated dark-matter experiment parasitically using the P2 electron beam dump; P2 itself is not counted again as a dark-matter experiment.
detection_principle: MESA electrons produce dark-sector particles in the downstream P2 dump. A shielded calorimeter measures scattering energy, with plastic-scintillator vetoes suppressing backgrounds.

science_scope: Tests dark-sector models by producing candidate particles or portal mediators at accelerators. Invisible accelerator final states or mediator particles alone do not establish cosmic-dark-matter identity; lifetimes, abundance and other experiments must also be considered.
